items.information: **STEPS OF REGISTRATION** Click On [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/M5OpenBBengaluru2025/register) Scroll Down Select the Events and register for the competition Make the Payment Click the [Payment Tab ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/M5OpenBBengaluru2025#65505-payment) for the Payment process after you are done with the registration below. The Participant should compulsorily register on WCA and should make the payment before November 5th 2025.. Please check your respective mail ID's through which you will receive all the communications from Speed Cubing Bangalore. **All the Newcomers** are requested to get their **valid ID proofs** with Date of Birth Mentioned on it. For the Returning Participants: Please claim your WCA ID if you have not claimed it yet. Link is provided below. [How To Claim your WCA ID](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3widl70-Uus) **First time participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA. You must mention your full name without any abbrevations while creating your WCA profile. Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - [Pay here](https://www.cubelelo.com/products/m5-open-b-bengaluru-2025-competition) **Returning participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - Register for the competition. Step 3 -[Pay here](https://www.cubelelo.com/products/m5-open-b-bengaluru-2025-competition) Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment. **Fees Structure:** Flat fee of ₹1000 irrespective of number of events Please do the payment of each participant separately. Note: 1) It is mandatory to pay the registration fees and also register on WCA to complete the full registration process. 2) It may take a day or 2 for your name to reflect on competitors list on WCA.
